question: Should the RareCloud Residential VPS (Constanta) be split from ip-proxy/rarecoud-and-vpckr into its own record with a dead verdict (registration-closed), leaving VPC.KR Korea VPS - Mini as the live half?
why: The stock line of the product read 0 Available in archived listings from 2026-02-24, and its store product page shows the Out of Stock notice (orders suspended) in an archived copy of 2026-04-29 and in reads of 2026-10-30 and 2026-11-02; its box left the live store listing between 2026-04-29 and 2026-06-09; its landing page was a 301 redirect to the generic Linux VPS page by 2026-09-06; the public catalog answers Product not found and the vendor's product index names no Residential VPS. The vendor states no withdrawal, so a withdrawn verdict is inferred, not stated. The record's verdict, its any-phone identity cost (RareCloud's form) and its binding note rest on both halves, while VPC.KR's form asks for an email only.
